title: Great Clock!
text: Great Clock!. I've been redecorating my bedroom. I got rid of my ugly digital clock and wanted something that looked nicer. This one looks great on my nightstand. It's not easy to read in the middle of the night, but I wear my smart watch while I'm sleeping, so I can easily check the time if needed. During the day, the clock is easy to read. It was easy to set the time. So far it seems to be keeping time well. It will definitely be easier to change the time during Daylight Savings Time!
